title: Safe Send
tagline: Transaction checker to see the status of any transaction to ensure that the transaction doesn't revert

prizes.placement: Pool for projects which use Dynamic
prizes.title: Pool for projects which use Dynamic

description: SafeSend is a decentralized application (DApp) built on the Starknet blockchain, designed to provide users with a simple yet powerful tool for checking transaction statuses. The app allows users to connect their Ethereum or Starknet wallets using Dynamic.xyz for authentication. Future enhancements could include features like transaction history tracking, real-time updates, and more detailed transaction breakdowns, further expanding its utility for Starknet users.
how_its_made: The project uses NextJS as the framework, and fetches data form the voyager api, as well as user auth using dynamic. Dynamic simplified the process of user authentication by allowing for both web2 and web3 accounts to enter. The project then checks transaction status through the voyager api.
